## Problem

Describe the problem and who or what it affects.

## Expected outcome

Describe what should be true when this Issue is resolved.

## Context and reproduction

Add relevant context, examples, logs, and related Issues. When applicable, include
reproduction steps, the environment, and actual versus expected results.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] Replace with concrete, verifiable completion criteria.

<!-- Default to criteria an AI agent can execute and verify. Require human
confirmation, physical-device testing, subjective evaluation, or external approval
only when necessary for this Issue; explain why and what result is expected.
All mandatory pre-merge criteria must be achievable and verifiable before merge.

## Optional validation

List useful additional checks that are not required for completion, or state None.

## Required post-merge verification

State None unless this Issue genuinely requires checks possible only after merge.
If required, describe the checks and expected results separately from pre-merge
acceptance. Keep them pending until performed; pre-merge validation does not prove
deployment or publication succeeded.
